lesson-philippine-constitution-accountab.quote: Cabinet Secretaries, legislators, and trial court judges are not impeachable officers. Supreme Court Members are on the list.
lesson-philippine-constitution-accountab.note: The added traps section supplies the required General Information closing section. Speed Tricks is optional under the approved ruling.

lesson-philippine-constitution-accountab.quote: Public officers and employees must answer to the people. They must do their work honestly, responsibly, and well.

lesson-philippine-constitution-accountab.note: The title comparison starts within the numbered solution in Example #2. No preliminary instruction sits outside it.

lesson-philippine-constitution-accountab.quote: Matching conduct to a ground only shows why that ground may be raised. It does not prove the facts, that the charge meets legal requirements, or guilt.
lesson-philippine-constitution-accountab.note: The added caution separates the ground check from factual proof, legal sufficiency, and guilt; the next sentence names House and Senate decision-making.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: This reading separates deliberate disobedience from an honest mistake.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The lesson explains intentional breach and gives a deliberate-disobedience application in Example #5.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Under criminal law, it includes levying war against the Philippines or siding with its enemies and giving them aid or comfort.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The lesson explains both forms and applies enemy assistance during wartime in Example #6.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Accepting money in return for an official favor may raise this ground.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The lesson explains the benefit-duty connection and tests money for an official act in Example #4.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Giving a favored company an unlawful contract advantage may raise this ground.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The lesson explains misuse for improper benefit and applies the contract-advantage case in Example #7.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Do not assume every crime qualifies because it is illegal.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The lesson gives seriousness and fitness-for-office limits, identifies interpretive uncertainty, and applies the open-ended phrase in Example #8.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: For example, repeatedly using official power in bad faith to favor allies at the public's expense may raise this ground.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The lesson gives actual conduct, bad faith, and seriousness rather than repeating the label alone. Example #9 applies it.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Conviction requires agreement by at least $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of all Senators.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: The lesson adds House initiation, both one-third routes, Senate trial, conviction threshold, judgment consequences, and the one-year bar.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: It may direct officials to perform and speed up duties required by law.
